name: Marathon
summary: The owner's running channel: a plus-size runner on the way from a 5K to the NYC Marathon. Real footage and data, no face. One video a week, posted by hand to its own accounts; the publisher never touches it.
cadence: One video a week, made on Sunday with Claude Code on the Mac (StudioZero).

goal.name: TCS New York City Marathon
goal.note: expected date: the first Sunday of November; confirm when NYRR announces

bring: Your brain dump: talk for 5–10 minutes about the week (paste it after the prompt or say it when asked)
Apple Health export: Health app › profile picture › Export All Health Data (or Fitness app screenshots)
Clips and voice memos from your runs
Last week's links and 7-day stats, if a video went up
